label: Seeded sample faults. These are written for the benchmark. They are not measurements from a plant.

cases.symptom: Centrifugal pump mechanical seal is leaking at the weep hole. Product is on the baseplate and the seal faces look scored. Vibration is steady.
Induction motor bearing noise started after the last grease round was skipped. The housing is warm and the noise tracks shaft speed.
Belt conveyor is mistracking. The belt walks off the tail pulley toward the structure within a minute of start.
Compressor high discharge temp alarm. The intercooler face is fouled and the discharge temperature climbs under load.
Control valve stiction. The stem sticks between 40% and 60% while the positioner output keeps moving.
Shell and tube heat exchanger tube leak. Process product is showing up in the cooling-water return.
Boiler low water alarm. The sight glass is empty and the burner has tripped.
MCC panel breaker trip on the pump starter. The cubicle smells hot and the breaker will not stay closed.
